name: protobuf
description: Protocol Buffers - Google's data interchange format
one_liner: Google's standard format for two different pieces of software to exchange structured data quickly and reliably — the invisible wiring behind countless APIs and microservices.
buyer: Not a purchasable product — every serious backend engineering team already uses it or something like it for free.
business_use_cases: A microservices company uses it as the contract format between internal services for speed and type-safety.
A mobile app team uses it to keep API payloads small on slow connections.
A gaming company uses it for fast client-server state sync.

money_ideas.idea: No direct monetization for an outside operator — it's foundational plumbing, not a product.

steal_this: No weekend product here; at most, offer API-migration consulting to teams moving from JSON/REST to protobuf/gRPC for performance reasons.
